mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right irrigation system installer for my luxury outdoor space?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an irrigation system installer for a luxury outdoor space, prioritize experience with high-end residential projects and a deep understanding of water conservation principles. Look for companies that offer custom design services tailored to your unique landscape, use high-quality, durable components, and provide comprehensive maintenance plans. Check their portfolio, client testimonials, and ensure they are licensed and insured in California. A reputable installer will prioritize efficiency, aesthetics, and long-term performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an installer with experience in luxury projects, custom design capabilities, high-quality components, and strong water conservation practices. Verify licenses and insurance.
